listing.name: Atlantis: The Lost Tales (Atlantis Native)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Native Rust port, no game data included, current desktop release packages. Limits: New native implementation with broad original-edition data support; completion claims remain upstream-only. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 ZIP; macOS Apple-Silicon ARM64 DMG; Linux x86-64 and ARM64 archives (glibc2.35+). Web nightly archive is a separate browser route. Original data: Supply owned Atlantis: The Lost Tales game files: a supported GOG installation or CD-derived folder with atlantis.exe and BIGCD1.BIG through BIGCD4.BIG (or the supported four disc images). Retained README accepts English 1997/2001, French May/August 1997, German August 1997, Dutch/Swedish June 1997, Spanish August 1997, Italian July 1997, patched 1.01/1999 and specified 1998 Traditional/1999 Simplified Chinese editions; preserve the selected release/language. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.

presentation.manual_preparation: On Play, use the upstream in-process library and original-data picker with your own supported Atlantis: The Lost Tales copy: the edition-matched atlantis.exe and BIGCD1.BIG through BIGCD4.BIG. Keep the complete original tree and supported language/build together; GOG and supported CD editions are alternatives, not interchangeable executables. Upstream can prepare your own discs/images; no game content is downloaded by this engine operation. This offer is Atlantis I only. Normal logs, games.txt, per-build players/checkpoints/settings live under the current account’s AppData/atlantis-native; when that location is unavailable the dedicated atlantis-native-data directory is relative to the creating runtime. Core preserves that declared local directory; it does not import or back up the shared external profile or originals. Preserve all actual original/profile roots and the compatible creating engine before changes. Normal start remains in one process; adding a second engine copy does not isolate shared profiles.
